parsed_answer:
The rs6152 variant is a single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) located in the **androgen receptor (AR)** gene. This SNP is located in the **promoter region** of the AR gene, specifically at position **-222 (relative to the transcription start site)**. 

Since rs6152 is located in the **promoter region**, it is not a protein-coding variant. Instead, it is a **regulatory variant** that may influence the transcriptional activity of the AR gene. Therefore, it does not directly affect the structure or function of the AR protein itself.

As a result, **protein-domain assignment is not applicable** for rs6152, because it does not encode any part of the AR protein. Its functional impact, if any, would be on gene expression levels or transcriptional regulation rather than on the protein structure or domains.
